title: Move the CI cron to 23:00, keeping the daily cadence
action: Per E2 change .github/workflows/ci.yml's schedule cron from '0 16 * * *' to '0 23 * * *'. Keep it once per day. Do NOT add a push or pull_request trigger -- the owner declined both, with the tradeoff stated. Per E9 this ships as a KNOWN PARTIAL fix and must not be described as closing anything: main can still carry a red for up to 24 hours and CI still only files an issue rather than blocking a commit. If ci.yml carries a comment describing the schedule's purpose, keep it honest -- do not write anything implying the change narrows the detection window, because it does not; it moves when the window opens.

truths: No push or pull_request trigger is added
The workflow still runs the full unscoped verify chain
key_links: no comment in the file claims the detection gap is closed
prohibitions: No new trigger of any kind
No change to the verify chain the workflow runs
No prose implying L4 is resolved

verify: node -e "const y=require('fs').readFileSync('.github/workflows/ci.yml','utf8'); if(!y.includes('0 23 * * *')) throw new Error('cron not moved to 23:00'); const m=y.match(/^on:\n([\s\S]*?)(?=^\S)/m); const on=m?m[1]:''; if(!on) throw new Error('could not isolate the on: block'); if(/pull_request|^\s+push:/m.test(on)) throw new Error('unexpected trigger inside the on: block'); console.log('ci.yml: cron 0 23 * * *, on: block carries no push/pull_request trigger');"
